web_searches.query: Munimenta Alme Universitatis Glasguensis, Index Nominum: Glasgow / Glasgu / Glasgwe / Glascw / Glasco
web_searches.site: University of Glasgow archive guide and digitized published index
web_searches.result: The heading mixes Glasgow place/office references with surname entries. Patricius appears as episcopus/archiepiscopus de (an office/place reference), not an identified student surnamed Glasgow. Andrew, Archibaldus, Joannes, Jacobus, Nathaniel and Stephanus appear as other indexed name leads; no identification with the Maryland minister or selected father is made.
web_searches.limitation: No claim that Patrick never studied or is absent from all university records. The official University guide warns that early attendance may leave no matriculation/graduation record.

research_state.last_test: Visually inspected the published Munimenta index, printed pp.55–56 (PDF167–168), under Glasgow and its listed variants. The Patricius entry refers to a bishop/archbishop of Glasgow, not an identified student surname. No minister or parent was identified in these two pages; individual register entries were not examined.
research_state.next_test: Locate an identifiable ordination, education or parish record for the All Hallows rector that names origin, a parent or a relative. Query the actual CCEd person/event search when accessible; the public form returned HTTP503 in this access test. Related synod records may be needed for the reported gap in presbytery minutes.
research_state.resume_when: An original or full source reading provides an education, origin, named relative or other identifier distinguishing the Maryland minister from the 1700 West Kilbride child.
research_state.review_conclusion: The university index check supplies no new parent evidence and does not exclude attendance or any retained childhood candidate. John Glasgow-3161 remains at 26% uncertain and James-634 at 95%; the reported death date remains 15 March 1753.
research_state.scope: Two published index pages visually inspected; separate catalogue/access scouts are not original-record negative searches.

prior_tests.test: Checked a published New Castle Presbytery history through indexed/OCR text: the 1736 Manokin ministry is described, but no parent or childhood identifier was located. No underlying page image was freshly inspected.
